summary: Feed s113_double is degraded: VLAN 20 missing (50% untagged) and SIEM port overloaded by bursts to 1.62 Gbps (162% of 1 Gbps capacity). Both cause visibility gaps for SIEM detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping or not forwarding VLAN 20 - 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is never observed, likely due to VLAN pruning/filter on broker or trunk port set to strip 802.1Q tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses segmentation context for VLAN 20; zone/tenant-based correlation and detection rules for VLAN 20 fail, creating blind spot for half the traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags and ensure both required VLANs 10 and 20 are forwarded to SIEM to restore complete segmentation visibility.

findings.root_cause: Aggregated feed bursts to 1.62 Gbps in 1ms intervals exceed the 1 Gbps SIEM port capacity (162% utilization, 6 overloaded intervals). Broker is feeding more traffic than single port can handle without load balancing or rate control.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM ingress drops packets during bursts, causing missed events, incomplete flow records, and gaps in detection/logging coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2x1G ports (or upgrade to 10G) to keep per-port utilization below 80% threshold and prevent burst-induced drops; alternatively apply filter/slice since SIEM needs_full_payload=false.
